speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-viral Cough Variant Asthma. The history of recent URI, nocturnal symptoms, and exertional dyspnea strongly suggests airway hyperreactivity rather than heart failure or pneumonia. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray results to confirm absence of infiltrates or cardiomegaly before finalizing treatment.
